interoceanic.definition:
a. Between oceans; connecting oceans; as, interoceanic
   communication; an interoceanic canal.

interoception.definition: n sensitivity to stimuli originating inside of the body

interoceptive.definition: a of or relating to interoception

interoceptor.definition: n. any receptor that responds to stimuli inside the body
interoceptor.translation:
n. 内感受器
[医] 内感受器

interocular.definition:
a. Between, or within, the eyes; as, the interocular
   distance; situated between the eyes, as the antennae of some insects.

interocular distance.translation: [医] 瞳孔间距离, 瞳孔距离

interocular lens implant.translation: [网络] 人工晶状体植入物

interofective system.translation: [医] 对内反应系统, 植物神经系统

interoffice communication.translation: [计] 办公室间通信, 局间通信

interoffice trunk.translation: [计] 局间干线; 局间中继线

interoperability.definition: n. (computer science) the ability to exchange and use information (usually in a large heterogeneous network made up of several local area networks)
interoperability.translation: [计] 互用性, 互操作性

interoperable.definition: s. able to exchange and use information
interoperable.translation: [计] 可互用的, 相互作用的, 相互配合的

interoperates.translation: (interoperate 的第三人称 -s形式) n. 交互操作

interoperating.translation: (interoperate 的现在分词) n. 交互操作

interoposition.translation: [医] 中间位, 同位, 介植, 补植, 插怖术(骨科)

interorbital.definition: a. Between the orbits; as, the interorbital septum.

interosculate.definition:
v. i. & t. To kiss together to touch. See Osculate.
v. i. & t. To have the character of, or to lie between,
   two distinct groups.
interosculate.translation:
vi. 接合, 结合, 联系, 有共同点
[医] 介在, 互通

interosseal.translation: [医] 骨间的, 骨间肌的

interosseous.definition: a. Situated between bones; as, an interosseous ligament.
interosseous.translation: a. [解]骨间的,小腿骨间的, 前臂骨间的

interosseous cartilage.translation: [医] 骨间软骨, 连接软骨

interosseous metatarsal ligaments.translation: [医] 跖骨间韧带, 底骨间韧带
